test_name: Stems attached at the notehead centre, false-hollow mode
description: Session 17, verification round 1. The shapes and the '(0 . 0) attachment of stem-centre.ly, with cnb:false-hollow #t. Each hollow head is one notehead group: the black ellipse, then a white ellipse painted over it. The stem is centred on the head and runs from the head's centre, the middle of the white hole, out past the head's far edge, so it crosses the whole half of the hole on its side. Because it follows the head (and so the white overlay inside it) in SVG document order, it is painted on top and stays visible. SVG y grows downward: an up stem's bbox.y is its far end.

assertions.description: A4 crotchet (false hollow), stem up: centred, from the head's centre past its top edge, painted over the white overlay
Eb5 crotchet (false hollow), stem down: centred, from the head's centre past its bottom edge, painted over the white overlay
A4 crotchet (false hollow), stem up, second occurrence of the head: centred, from the head's centre past its top edge, painted over the white overlay
